analysis.primaryGoal: Drive sales by incentivizing customers with a free Mystery Box gift on minimum order values.
analysis.audience: Existing customers and prospects interested in Westpack packaging or related products.
analysis.offer: Få en gratis Mystery Box ved køb over bestemte beløbsgrænser.

layoutPatterns: vertical journey with tiered steps visualized
visualStyle.imageStyle: soft-edged product photos, festive overlays, rounded highlighting

copyStyle.urgency: implied urgency—promotion period, enthusiastic CTAs, surprise factor

reusablePatterns: Gift-with-purchase mechanic communicated simply up top
Visual progression with stepwise illustration for tiered rewards
Multiple CTA buttons at key decision points (learn more, purchase, claim offer)
